(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the enclosure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 11 further comprising: a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a contact sensor that utilizes force sensing material specifically tailored for connection with the first battery cell.
